content.comment_body: Hello, I am searching for [product_name] and would like to know where I can download it. Can anyone assist me? [user_name]
Typically, [product_name] is not available for free, though there might be some regions where it is provided without charge. If you already own a full version, you can access a free upgrade at [url].

I've used [product_name] for both personal and professional purposes over the years. Now that I'm retired and using a Mac at home, I only have the complete PC version. I would prefer not to repurchase the software, even if I could figure out where and how to do so. Is there any way to resolve this? Some time ago, during the pandemic, I reached out to the forum and received a link to download it for free. Unfortunately, after rebuilding my Mac, I lost the link and the installation package, and I haven't been able to locate them in my archives. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

A complete version download from [company_name] isn't available; only demo versions are offered. Download links are provided solely for upgrades. The upgrade to the latest [version_no] can be found under: Download links for current [product_name] software and firmware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter challenges obtaining and downloading the full version of [product_name], particularly when moving to a different operating system. Licensing terms, free availability, upgrades, and retention of access after hardware or OS changes are unclear. This impacts usability and satisfaction, especially for long-time users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to conveniently download and reinstall [product_name], ideally without having to purchase again, and wish for licences or access to be transferable between operating systems.
